title.en: A lemma is a term too

t.zh: 证过的引理在证明项里写成它的名字：用了<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>，证明项里就是 chain p q。名字背后是证出它的那个证明项。
t.en: A lemma you proved appears in a term by its name: use <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>, and the term says chain p q. Behind the name is the term that proved it.

briefNote.zh: 证明项须为 chain p q。
briefNote.en: Its proof term must be chain p q.

briefNote.zh: 不用<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>，证明项须为 fun h => q (p h)。
briefNote.en: Do not use <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>; the proof term must be fun h => q (p h).

hint.zh: 当初证<part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>时接的是什么？
hint.en: What did you wire when you proved <part-ref to="lemma:chain"></part-ref>?
